title: 第18章 碎岩凶鼠
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
盘腿坐在床上，林奇将卡牌一一摊开，铺满了半个床面。

    “上午在万卡阁买的卡牌都融合完了。现在我手里有两张骷髅勇士，可以尝试给本命卡改变资质。”

    在源卡大陆，本命卡的资质改变向来是难如登天。

    通常情况下，只有御卡师从二星卡徒晋升为三星御卡师时，辅以各种珍贵的材料，找到自己合适的路线，才有极小的几率让本命卡发生蜕变。

    像林奇这样，仅仅是一星卡徒，就已经将无色本命卡蜕变成白色一星卡的情况，在大陆上是十分罕见的情况。

    林奇深吸一口气，将两张二星骷髅勇士召唤卡与自己的本命卡骷髅士兵放在一起，集中精神激活了规则卡。

    “融合。”

    几秒过后，想象中的漩涡并没有出现，反而有一段冰冷的信息，突兀地浮现在他的脑海里。

    “卡牌星级不对等，不符合融合规则。”

    林奇拿着本命卡愣住了。

    “啥意思？还不能跨星融合？”

    他本命卡是一星，而骷髅勇士是二星，星级不同，竟然无法融合！

    “还好，我这里还有新买的十张一星骷髅小兵卡，星级是对等的。”

    林奇很快调整好心态，将两张二星卡放到一边，拿起一张骷髅小兵卡，再次与本命卡放在一起。

    “融合！”

    这一次，漩涡瞬间出现，将本命卡和骷髅小兵卡一同吞噬。

    仅仅几秒钟后，漩涡消散，一张全新的卡牌落在林奇手中。

    召唤卡，持剑的骷髅勇士

    星级：一星

    品质：绿色

    技能1：无畏冲锋，短时间内得到加持，提升自身攻击与速度。

    技能2：基础剑术，攻击+10

    评价：这是一位持剑的勇士，也是战场上你值得信任的战友。

    （本命卡的星级是对应御卡师的等级的。林奇是一星卡徒，所以他的本命卡品质无论怎么蜕变，星级也是一星，倘若林奇突破了二星卡徒，那么本命卡的星级也会变为二星。）

    “哈哈哈哈！绿色品质！终于成功了！”

    林奇激动地挥舞了一下拳头，紧接着又冒出一个更大胆的想法。

    “既然绿色品质都成了，不如一口气试试突破到蓝色品质！”

    他立刻从床铺上拿起那两张二星骷髅勇士卡，再次与刚融合成功的绿色本命卡放在一起。

    “融合！”

    林奇紧紧盯着漩涡，眼睛一眨不眨，期待着能看到代表蓝色品质的光芒。可漩涡消散后，落在他手中的卡牌，依旧是绿色品质，只是多了一个天赋。

    召唤卡，持剑骷髅

    星级：一星

    资质：绿色

    天赋：勇敢的心

    技能1：无畏冲锋，短时间内得到加持，提升自身攻击与速度。

    技能2：基础剑术，攻击+10。掌握简单的劈、砍、刺技巧。

    评价：这是一具骨骼十分强壮的骷髅勇士，强大的力量带给了他无所畏惧的心灵。（假如骷髅有心的话…）

    “还是绿色？两张二星绿卡竟然不够？”

    林奇皱起眉，不甘心地将剩下的九张一星骷髅小兵卡全部拿过来，一股脑地与本命卡放在一起。

    “融合！我就不信了，九张白卡加两张绿卡，还突破不了蓝色！”

    漩涡将骷髅小兵全部融入进去，这次并没有出现什么星级不融合。
content_en:
Sitting cross-legged on the bed, Lynch spread out the cards one by one, covering half of the bed.

"The cards I bought at Wanka Pavilion in the morning have been integrated. Now I have two Skeleton Warriors in my hand, and I can try to change the qualifications of the natal cards."

In the Source Card Continent, it has always been extremely difficult to change the qualifications of a natal card.

Under normal circumstances, only when a card master is promoted from a two-star card apprentice to a three-star card master, and supplemented by various precious materials and finds his own suitable route, can he have a very small chance of transforming his natal card.

It is very rare for a one-star card disciple like Lin Qi to transform his colorless natal card into a white one-star card on the mainland.

Lynch took a deep breath, put the two two-star Skeleton Warrior summoning cards together with his own Skeleton Soldier card, and concentrated on activating the rule card.

"Fusion."

A few seconds later, the whirlpool in his imagination did not appear. Instead, a piece of cold information suddenly appeared in his mind.

"The card stars are not equal and do not comply with the fusion rules."

Lin Qi was stunned as he held his birth card.

"What do you mean? You can't integrate across stars yet?"

His life card is one star, and the Skeleton Warrior is two stars. The star cards are different, and they can't be fused!

"Fortunately, I also have ten new one-star skeleton minion cards that I bought here. The stars are equal."

Lynch quickly adjusted his mentality, put the two two-star cards aside, picked up a skeleton minion card, and put it together with the life card again.

"Fusion!"

This time, the vortex appeared instantly and swallowed the life card and the skeleton minion card together.

Just a few seconds later, the vortex dissipated, and a brand new card fell into Lynch's hand.

Summoning card, sword-wielding skeleton warrior

Star rating: one star

Quality: green

Skill 1: Fearless charge, receive blessing in a short time, increase own attack and speed.

Skill 2: Basic swordsmanship, attack +10

Evaluation: This is a sword-wielding warrior and your trustworthy comrade on the battlefield.

(The star level of the natal card corresponds to the level of the card master. Lynch is a one-star card disciple, so no matter how the quality of his natal card changes, the star level is still one star. If Lynch breaks through the two-star card disciple, then the star level of the natal card will also become two stars.)

"Hahahaha! Green quality! Finally succeeded!"

Lynch waved his fist excitedly, and then came up with a bolder idea.

"Now that the green quality has been achieved, why not try to break through to the blue quality in one go!"

He immediately picked up the two two-star skeleton warrior cards from the bed and put them together with the green natal card that had just been successfully fused.

"Fusion!"

Lynch stared at the vortex tightly, his eyes unblinking, expecting to see the light that represented the quality of blue.But after the vortex dissipated, the card that fell into his hand was still of green quality, but it had an extra talent.

Summoning card, sword-wielding skeleton

Star rating: one star

Qualification: Green

Talent: Brave Heart

Skill 1: Fearless charge, receive blessing in a short time, increase own attack and speed.

Skill 2: Basic swordsmanship, attack +10.Master simple hacking, slashing and stabbing techniques.

Evaluation: This is a skeleton warrior with very strong bones. His powerful strength gives him a fearless mind.(If the skeleton has a heart...)

"Still green? Two two-star green cards are not enough?"

Lin Qi frowned and reluctantly took all the remaining nine one-star skeleton minion cards and put them together with the life cards.

"Fusion! I don't believe it. Nine white cards plus two green cards can't break through the blue!"

The whirlpool integrated all the skeleton soldiers into it, and this time there was no star disintegration.
